# Source: A Witches' Sabbath

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** A Witches' Sabbath
- **Artist / culture:** Cornelis Saftleven (Dutch, 1607–1681)
- **Date:** c. 1650
- **Style:** dutch
- **Classification:** oil on panel
- **Department:** Painting and Sculpture of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 53495
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/53495
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/8cd4328f-da34-dec3-00f5-5810a747c8e8/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Halloween and Ghost Tales

## Extracted source palette

`#181808, #382818, #484838, #685838, #583818, #786858, #888868, #987848`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C04`
- `surface`: `#282821`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#987848`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#181808`
- `surface_variant`: `#282821`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E48`
- `error`: `#987848`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.46:1`, surface `13.95:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.95:1`
- Control contrast: `4.76:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
